name: home
description: francisdesjardins.ca — the front door, and the index of what the packages here are.
author: Francis Desjardins <francis.desjardins@gmail.com>

scripts.check: yarn type-check && yarn lint --deny-warnings && yarn format:check && yarn check:contrast && yarn check:literals && yarn check:head && yarn check:tokens:used && yarn comment-budget
scripts.test: echo "home: no-op — no test files yet"
scripts.check:head: node scripts/check-head.mjs

skip.examples: This app publishes nothing, and the gate's unit of work is a published specifier: it compiles each @example against the entry it belongs to, and there is no entry here. The two examples in `useDocumentHead` are therefore prose the compiler never reads, which is the cost of the omission rather than an argument against it.
